title: Add chart-transmission Helm chart
description: Build a Helm chart and Taskfile wrapper for running transmission-daemon in Kubernetes, modeled on chart-varnish-git and the existing transmission-daemon-compose.yml docker-compose stack. Reuses ghcr.io/andrewrothstein/ansible-transmission. Provides singleton Deployment with PVCs for /downloads and /watch, ClusterIP service for WebUI (9091), and configurable service type for peer port (51413 TCP/UDP).
close_reason: Chart and taskfile created; helm lint + helm template + pre-commit all pass
